title: The best
body: A pretty useful app and a timer with almost no setup friction. A great addition would be Live Activities on the Lock Screen.
author: Nerdux

title: Doesn’t work properly on iOS
body: I don’t see the point of this app existing for iOS, since it doesn’t ring or vibrate when the app is not opened and the silent mode is on, or when the app is running on background. At least that’s what happens to me. I’ve searched the user’s guide to fix it but with no success. It rings when the app is opened and running, you can’t lock the screen. I believe this is an iOS issue, because alarm apps are also useless in iOS, the only one they support is their own alarm app.
author: Tay Nakakuma
